findings: All three SA-neg grids give a 4.59–5.10 mm separated interval. The corresponding SST-2003m interval is 21.17–23.56 mm. The tested closure effect is larger than the spread across this grid family. The sequence does not establish an asymptotic grid-convergence order.

With the same starting field and 1,050 additional iterations, the coarse SA interval is 4.89 mm with an adiabatic wall and 2.94 mm with a 300 K wall (39.9% shorter). This controlled thermal change does not reconcile the entire reference spread.
The Wilcox SST branch had 0.00345% terminal mass error, yet a 7.20 mm shift in its wall separation marker. It remains on hold for steady convergence.
